title: The shop street's roofs and the seafront south of the plaza
caption: On the island map the shop street south of the fountain plaza used to be two rows of plain grey boxes with sea right behind them. Now each row is small buildings with their own heights and roofs under a ribbed glass arcade, and behind them a promenade, a sea wall with three flights of stairs down to a beach, and the wall on armour rocks where it meets the sea, the same coast as west of the station. Backdrop only: day 1 never walks here (issue #143).
